Then search web for recent reviews of that cheapest vendor and summarise them. End with line 'Best price: <vendor>'.

We have data for each vendor:

Acme: unit 742, qty 50 => subtotal 37,100. Shipping 450. Total delivered 37,550. Lead time 14 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

Orbital: unit 760, qty 50 => 38,000. Volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units. So discount 4% of 38,000 = 1,520. So total delivered 36,480. Shipping included. Lead time 10 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

BrightPath: unit 715, qty 50 => 35,750. Shipping 0. Total delivered 35,750. Lead time 21 calendar days. Warranty 2 years on-site.

Nimbus: unit 728, qty 50 => 36,400. Express shipping 300. Total delivered 36,700. Lead time 7 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

So cheapest total delivered price is BrightPath at 35,750. Next Orbital 36,480. Nimbus 36,700. Acme 37,550.

Thus cheapest vendor is BrightPath Systems.

The results show BrightPath Systems - customer reviews URL: https://reviews.example/vendors/brightpath-systems. It says rated 4.0/5 by business customers for aggressive pricing.
